findings.title: After the gate's sign-in the screen shows RO while the account was saved as EN
steps: sign up via API
open /app/driver, sign in in the dialog
second tab: open /app/driver, tap "Ieși din cont"
first tab: next PATCH /me carries an expired token
tap EN in "Limba"
sign in in the gate dialog
look at the dashboard language; sign in via API and GET /api/v1/me

findings.title: After signing in through the gate, the resent language save reaches the server but the screen reverts: the dashboard shows RO while the account is saved as EN
steps: Sign in on /app/driver (account language ro)
In a second tab, open /app/driver and tap "Ieși din cont" (the refresh cookie is now refused)
In the first tab, the next PATCH /api/v1/me is refused 401 sign_in_required (an expired access token)
Tap EN in "Limba": the gate opens with "Sign in to continue."
Sign in in the dialog: the dialog closes on /app/driver and PATCH /api/v1/me {language:"en"} is sent once with the new token and answers 200
Look at the dashboard: it is in Romanian with RO selected; GET /api/v1/me says language "en"
findings.evidence: shots/flows/A-after-sign-in-390.png; flows notes: "after gate sign-in server language=en, UI language=ro". Session.signIn() -> load() runs `if (answer) void this.language.choose(answer.language);` (session.ts:99) with the account's old 'ro', then the resent save's answer is dropped by `if (this.current() !== me) return;` (session.ts:143) because current() is the freshly loaded account. FR-005 requires the repeated call's answer to go to the code that made it, and US2/US3 that the person goes on where they were; the only end-to-end flow the spec names (the language save) ends with the screen contradicting both the tap and the account. The e2e misses it: its GET /me stub always returns `driver` with language 'ro' (sign-in-gate.spec.ts:38) and it only asserts the recorded saves (line 89), never the screen's language. Fix with a test first: after the gated sign-in the screen shows the tapped language and the account holds it.

findings.title: The public-route test enumerates the OpenAPI document, not every route the API serves, so the Brevo webhook (the 7th public route of FR-002) and any future @ApiExcludeController route are outside it
steps: Read FR-002: the public list is seven routes including POST /api/v1/webhooks/brevo, and "a test MUST enumerate every route the API serves"
Read the test: `routes = Object.entries(openApiDocument(app).paths)` and `const PUBLIC = [...]` has six entries
findings.evidence: BrevoWebhookController carries @ApiExcludeController() and @Public(), so it never appears in `openApiDocument(app).paths`. A route hidden from OpenAPI and marked @Public() by mistake would pass this test. Enumerating Nest's router (e.g. the Express router stack or DiscoveryService/MetadataScanner) instead of the document would cover what the API really serves, and the expected list would then match FR-002's seven.

findings.title: tasks.md T001 is ticked but its expired-token case is not in the route-list test
steps: T001 says: call each route "without a token, a malformed token and an expired one"
The it.each covers a malformed token, a token signed with another key and another scheme; no expired token
findings.evidence: The expired case is tested once, on one route, in libs/domain/src/auth/actor.guard.adversary.integration.spec.ts ('answers 401 for an expired token'); either add it to the route sweep or correct the task text.

findings.title: Behind the gate dialog the dashboard drops the person's name and collapses its menu to one item
findings.where: apps/web/src/app/dashboard/session.ts (renew() -> forget() on a refused renewal), apps/web/src/app/dashboard/frame.ts
steps: Signed in on /app/driver, end the session elsewhere, tap EN
With the gate open, look behind it: the name is gone and the menu shows only "Dashboard" (or "Panou")
findings.evidence: shots/flows/A-gate-open-390.png, shots/flows/E-gate-desktop-light-en.png. The refused renewal calls forget(), which clears current(); the frame renders from it. The spec wants the screen behind the dialog to stay as left; the menu and name come back after sign-in.

notes: No Docker on this machine: private PostgreSQL and Redis on free ports, no object store.
No changed GET endpoint without path parameters.

Tester removed its own flow finding "Escape does not close the gate dialog": the sheet showed the shared overlay's "Discard your changes?" confirmation because the e-mail field was filled (intended behaviour; shots/flows/B-gate-closed-320-dark.png).

Flows: API deny-by-default over all 12 OpenAPI operations (no token, malformed, foreign-key token) = only the 6 public routes open; brevo webhook 401 by its own secret check; gate opened from a real ended session (second-tab sign-out, real refresh refused), real sign-in and sign-up inside the gate each resent the PATCH once with the new token, same address; wrong password in the gate keeps one dialog; reload signed-out opens the plain dialog without the reason; Autentificare from Home has no reason line; gate dialog swept 4 viewports x light/dark x ro/en (axe, overflow) clean. Affected tests 7 projects green; e2e 217/217 passed.
